identity.symptom: scalar api reference returns 404 for a default app

what: Inspector Scalar link returns 404 for default applications.
expected: The standalone inspector opens Scalar using the application OpenAPI document.
observed: The navigation targeted an optional backend UI route; the OpenAPI document itself returned 200.
root_cause: apps/inspector/lib/api-reference.ts linked to the backend Scalar endpoint even though default applications do not select apiDocs.ui=scalar.
fixed_by: Host Scalar at the inspector /scalar route, load the same-origin OpenAPI proxy, and update the shared navigation URL and browser regression. Rebuilt and restarted the local standalone inspector.

invariants: Try requests use the existing same-origin application proxy

reproduction: Run default demo77 with inspector enabled and no apiDocs.ui setting

after.note: Fixed navigation target returns Scalar HTML

before.assertion: Scalar navigation targets the inspector-owned page

after.assertion: Scalar navigation targets the inspector-owned page; HTML uses the OpenAPI proxy

before.assertion: The Scalar navigation target serves HTML successfully

after.assertion: The Scalar navigation target serves HTML successfully

e2e.command: Owned playwrightSuite/runPlaywright harness: bun x playwright test tests/e2e/inspector-redesign.spec.ts --grep "renders the Scalar reference"
e2e.assertion: API reference link, screenshot and inspector-owned HTML route pass

regressions.command: Bun Playwright Chromium browser: open /scalar, Test Request (get /hello), Send get request, assert response
regressions.assertion: Real demo77 Scalar UI renders and sends a proxied GET /hello returning 200 and Hello, world!
regressions.boundary: Scalar browser -> inspector proxy -> demo77 real application

limitations: Full monorepo suite was not run.
Scalar uses its existing upstream CDN distribution and requires network access.

notes: Production next build and standalone packaging succeeded; demo77 inspector restarted on 3210. Backend kept running.
The browser fixture has no public OpenAPI document endpoint; the existing E2E checks inspector navigation and HTML while real demo77 browser validation covers document rendering and Try Request.
